definitions.explanation: Small scissors with curved, pointed blades designed for trimming fingernails and toenails, especially for cuticles or babies' nails.

examples.japanese: {爪切|つめき}りばさみ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{爪|つめ}→爪：02159_tsume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧。
examples.english: I trim my nails with nail scissors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{爪切|つめき}りばさみ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧だ。
examples.english: Nail scissors are safer for babies.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{丸|まる}い→丸い：02967_marui⟧{爪切|つめき}りばさみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}えば→使う：00473_tsukau⟧、⟦{皮膚|ひふ}→皮膚：03987_hifu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{傷|きず}つけ→傷つける：01935_kizutsukeru⟧にくい。
examples.english: Using round-tipped nail scissors makes it harder to injure the skin.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{爪切|つめき}り→爪切り：05287_tsumekiri⟧ (nail trimming) + ⟦はさみ→はさみ：00702_hasami⟧ (scissors).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {爪切|つめき}りばさみ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to cut with nail scissors
- ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{爪切|つめき}りばさみ: nail scissors for babies
- ⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{丸|まる}い→丸い：02967_marui⟧{爪切|つめき}りばさみ: round-tipped nail scissors

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{爪切|つめき}り→爪切り：05287_tsumekiri⟧: nail clippers — the standard lever-type clipper, more common for adults
- ⟦{裁|た}ちばさみ→裁ちばさみ：27476_tachibasami⟧: fabric scissors — larger scissors for cloth, contrasted by purpose
